name: Build a quote or proposal from notes, photos or plans
summary: Builds a quote or proposal from the request and its notes, photos or plans. The agent reads the material and sets the lines; the crons price them from the rate card, draft the quote in the business's own system and queue its send for approval, chase sent quotes, and hand a won quote over. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

priced-job-from-site-visit.evidence: 33 of the 40 calls read for steps describe this way of quoting

covered_by.receive-brief: skill (reads the request, its photos and plans)
covered_by.site-visit: skill (visit notes and photos go into a proposal)
covered_by.price-build: draft (rate card lines, or the proposal lines)
covered_by.internal-approval: approval (every send waits in the CRM shell)
covered_by.margin-review: skill (the margin is set on the proposal line as unitPrice)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (the quote record and its PDF in the platform)

proposal-scope-services.evidence: 7 of the 40 calls read for steps describe this way of quoting

covered_by.qualify: skill (decides whether the job is worth a proposal)
covered_by.receive-brief: skill (reads the request and its notes)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (the quote record in the platform)
covered_by.write-proposal: draft (the proposal lines, priced by the draft cron)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New quote requests from each intake source.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Price from the rate card or the agent's proposal, draft the quote, queue its send for approval.

crons.name: follow-up
crons.summary: Queue follow-ups on sent quotes that are due (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: handover
crons.summary: An accepted quote becomes a draft invoice, or nothing when the platform sets up the job.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a job in Quote status, its lines, a quote PDF filed to the job diary, a Xero quote, contact or invoice in DRAFT, an email draft, a register row. Anything that sends or changes a quote's status is a live operation and waits for a person.

servicem8.covers: enquiry intake (jobs in Quote status), rate card, quote as a job with lines and PDF, send and follow-up by email or SMS

xero.covers: rate card, quote, PDF, status, handover as a draft invoice; sending goes through the mailbox

microsoft-365.covers: Outlook intake and drafts, Excel rate card and register; needed by the Xero adapter to send

gaps: HubSpot has the most support in the evidence (7 steps yes, 3 partial, 6 mapped operations for quotes and line items), but it has no adapter yet. Quote and line-item property names (title, expiry, amount, product) are not in the HubSpot spec in the endpoint map, so they cannot be checked. Add an adapter once they are confirmed there.
MYOB: 4 steps are supported in the evidence, but the kit maps only a read of a sale quote. No write, so no adapter.
Supplier and subcontractor price requests (supplier-prices, 12 calls, 92% manual): agent skill. The owner's usual way, recorded as a proposal.
Measure-scope and takeoff (20 calls): agent skill. Quantities go into a proposal. The kit has no takeoff adapter (Bluebeam, PlanSwift, Groundplan, Tally) for this workflow.
Revisions after a send (revise, 2 calls): not covered. Handled by hand.
The worklist's CRM entry 'proposal-web' has no kit adapter. Proposals enter through the propose command and the store.
Microsoft 365 is named in 12 quoting calls but is not in the platform evidence file. It is included because the Xero adapter sends through it.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox account (ServiceM8 trial, Xero demo company, Microsoft 365 developer tenant) proves it.

Needs a change in the construction ServiceM8 adapter (industries/construction/workflows/sales/quoting/adapters/servicem8.ts, draftQuote), not made here: on a retry after a partial failure, line creation is skipped whenever any line already exists on the job, so the job can keep fewer lines than the emailed quote total. The fix is to create only the missing lines and refuse the send unless the job's lines add up to the quote total.

Needs a change in the same ServiceM8 adapter, not made here: the job id from the stored enquiry goes into OData filters on the job-lines and attachments reads without the UUID check the rest of that file applies. Low risk today, because the stored id is only written from UUID-checked values.

evidence.calls: 116 discovery calls in the worklist; 40 read in depth for steps, variants and families
evidence.platforms: the vendors' own help centres for HubSpot, MYOB, ServiceM8 and Xero, mapped step by step; operations checked against the kit's ops.json
